cohort: 27 adenomyotic patients with primary infertility who underwent HIFU treatment
finding: HIFU treatment for adenomyosis could improve fertility of patients with primary infertility and is a promising therapeutic approach for patients who wish to achieve pregnancy and have live birth deliveries.
mod_finding: Of the eight live births, four (50%) were born vaginally and four (50%) by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of newborns was 3.1 kg (range: 2.3-3.9 kg)
